features.vestingText: Employer discretionary matching and non-elective contributions plus actual earnings become fully vested after three years of service with no partial vesting prior to three years of service.
features.loansText: Notes Receivable from Participants Participants may borrow a minimum of $1,000 up to a maximum of the lesser of 50% of their respective vested balances or $50,000 by executing a note in accordance with the Plan’s provisions.
